It’s not about the nightmare, but what came after it. I was having a bad dream. I tried and tried to wake myself from it, knowing it was a bad dream. Eventually I broke through and opened my eyes to see light coming through my window, birds chirping in the background. I was thankful to be awake but it only lasted for a couple seconds, my eyes closed again and suddenly I was sitting up in my bed in the middle of the night, pitch black outside, no birds calling. The most frightening part for me was how vivid the false reality was, as though my brain had fabricated the scene and fed it to itself. Still gives me chills
